content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-188. - Severance pay.
content.summary:
If the city manager determines that it is in the best interest of the city, they may
               authorize severance pay or benefits to any employee who terminates or separates from
               city employment for any reason.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
